# CoreAge Rx — Refund, Return, Subscription & Shipping Policy

At CoreAge Rx, we are committed to providing safe, transparent, and convenient access to licensed medical providers and prescription treatments.

If you experience an issue with your order, please contact our Patient Care Team at [+1 307-405-1638](tel:+13074051638) or [support@coreagerx.com](mailto:support@coreagerx.com).

## 1\. How Your Order Works

After placing an order, you may be required to complete certain steps before a provider can review and fulfill your treatment.

The typical process is:

1. **Step 1 — Place your order.**

Select your treatment and complete checkout.
2. **Step 2 — Complete your medical intake.**

You must provide all information and documentation requested for your treatment.
3. **Step 3 — Provider review.**

A licensed medical provider reviews your information and determines whether treatment is medically appropriate.
4. **Step 4 — Pharmacy fulfillment.**

If approved, your prescription is transmitted to a licensed pharmacy for compounding and fulfillment.
5. **Step 5 — Shipment.**

Once your medication ships, you will receive tracking information by email.

When all required information is submitted promptly, orders are typically completed within approximately 5–7 business days, although processing times may vary.

### Information We May Require

Your order cannot proceed until all required information has been received. Depending on your treatment, this may include:

- Completed medical intake forms
- Health history
- Current medications
- Valid photo identification
- Patient photographs
- Lab results
- Medical records
- Primary care provider documentation
- Responses to provider questions
- Correct shipping or contact information
- Any other information reasonably required for medical review or prescription fulfillment

Please monitor your email, text messages, patient portal, and spam/junk folders after placing an order.

Failure to provide requested information may delay or prevent your order from being completed.

## 2\. One-Time Purchases, Subscriptions & Automatic Renewals

CoreAge Rx may offer both one-time purchases and subscription plans with automatic renewals, depending on the treatment or plan you select.

If you enroll in a subscription, the applicable price, billing frequency, renewal terms, and other material subscription terms will be presented to you at the time of purchase.

By enrolling in an automatically renewing plan, you authorize CoreAge Rx to charge your selected payment method at each applicable renewal until you cancel the subscription.

### Canceling a Subscription

You may cancel your subscription at any time to prevent future renewal charges by using the available cancellation option in your patient account or by contacting our Patient Care Team.

Canceling a subscription:

- Stops future automatic renewals.
- Does not automatically cancel or refund an order that has already been processed.
- Does not provide a refund for medication already approved, submitted for pharmacy fulfillment, compounded, dispensed, or shipped.
- Does not provide a refund for an order that has otherwise become non-refundable under this policy.

To avoid your next renewal charge, your cancellation request must be received before the applicable renewal is processed.

## 3\. Shipping & Delivery

- **Shipping Method:** Standard shipping through USPS, UPS, FedEx, or another designated carrier.
- **Shipping Cost:** Standard shipping is included on prescription medication orders unless otherwise disclosed at checkout.
- **Estimated Delivery:** Medication typically arrives within approximately 2–3 business days after the pharmacy ships the order.

The total time between purchase and delivery may be longer because medical review, documentation, prescription approval, and pharmacy compounding must occur before shipment.

### Tracking

Tracking information will be provided once available from the pharmacy or shipping carrier.

### Lost or Damaged Packages

If your medication is lost or damaged during transit, contact our Patient Care Team promptly.

After reviewing the circumstances, CoreAge Rx will work with the pharmacy and/or carrier to arrange an appropriate replacement or reshipment when applicable.

## 4\. Refund & Cancellation Policy

### Before Provider Approval and Pharmacy Fulfillment

You may request to cancel an order if:

- Your prescription has not yet been approved by a licensed provider; and
- Your prescription/order has not yet been transmitted to the pharmacy for fulfillment; and
- The order has not otherwise become non-refundable under the 30-Day Patient Documentation Policy below.

Any applicable non-refundable provider consultation fee will be deducted from the refund.

### If You Are Not Medically Eligible

If a licensed provider determines that you are not medically eligible for the treatment you purchased, the refundable treatment or medication portion of your payment will be returned to your original payment method.

Any applicable provider consultation fee of $50–$100 is non-refundable, because the medical consultation and eligibility review have already been performed.

### When Prescription Orders Become Final

**ALL PRESCRIPTION SALES ARE FINAL** once your prescription has been:

- Approved by a licensed medical provider; and
- Transmitted to the pharmacy for fulfillment.

Once this occurs, the order cannot be canceled, returned, or refunded.

This applies even if:

- The medication has not yet shipped.
- You change your mind about treatment.
- You no longer wish to take the medication.
- You purchase treatment elsewhere.
- You request cancellation after pharmacy fulfillment has begun.

Prescription medications are prepared and dispensed for an individual patient and cannot generally be returned to pharmacy inventory after dispensing.

## 5\. 30-Day Refund Cutoff

All orders become final and non-refundable 30 calendar days after the original purchase date.

Once 30 calendar days have passed from the date of purchase, no refund will be issued for any reason, regardless of whether the medication has shipped or the order has been completed, except where otherwise required by applicable law.

This includes orders delayed or unable to proceed because required patient information has not been provided, including:

- Medical intake forms
- Valid photo identification
- Patient photographs
- Lab results
- Medical records
- Primary care provider documentation
- Health history or medication information
- Responses to provider questions
- Address or identity verification
- Any other information or documentation required to review, prescribe, or fulfill treatment

Patients are responsible for completing all requested steps and providing all required information within 30 calendar days of purchase.

Failure to complete these requirements within the 30-day period does not extend the refund window.

After 30 calendar days, the order remains non-refundable even if:

- The prescription has not yet been approved.
- The prescription has not yet been sent to the pharmacy.
- The medication has not been compounded.
- The medication has not been shipped.
- Additional information or documentation is still required from the patient.
- The patient no longer wishes to continue treatment.

Requests to cancel or receive a refund must therefore be submitted and eligible for refund within 30 calendar days of the original purchase date.

This 30-day cutoff applies to the individual order or renewal charge being refunded and does not prevent a patient from canceling a subscription to stop future renewal charges.

## 6\. Non-Refundable Provider Consultation Fees

Provider consultation fees are non-refundable once the consultation or medical review process has begun.

Depending on the treatment purchased, the consultation fee may range from $50–$100.

The consultation fee may remain non-refundable even if:

- You cancel before pharmacy fulfillment.
- The provider determines that treatment is not medically appropriate.
- You change your mind.
- You fail to submit required documents or information.
- Your order becomes non-refundable under the 30-Day Patient Documentation Policy.

## 7\. Refund Processing

When a refund is approved:

- **Refund Method:** Refunds are issued to the original payment method used for the purchase.
- This may include Visa, Mastercard, American Express, debit card, Klarna, Affirm, or another payment method offered at checkout.
- **Processing Time:** Approved refunds are generally processed within 5–10 business days.

Your financial institution may require additional time before the refund appears in your account.

### Klarna / Affirm

If you used Klarna, Affirm, or another financing provider, any approved refund will be submitted through that provider. The provider will determine how the refund affects any remaining installment payments or account balance.

## 8\. Non-Prescription Products

Unopened, non-prescription products may be returned within 30 days of delivery, unless otherwise stated at the time of purchase.

Products must be:

- Unopened
- Unused
- Sealed
- In their original condition

Return shipping is the customer’s responsibility unless the product was damaged, defective, or shipped incorrectly.

COD returns are not accepted.

To request a return, contact [support@coreagerx.com](mailto:support@coreagerx.com) and include your order number.

Roughly two-thirds of lost weight returns within 12 months of discontinuing semaglutide in published extension data. This is the body's setpoint reasserting itself, not a moral failure.

## When this isnot for you.

GLP-1 medications have real contraindications per the FDA black-box label. We publish them here, before the consultation.

- 01Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma
- 02Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN-2)
- 03History of severe pancreatitis
- 04Currently pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding
- 05Severe gastrointestinal disease (gastroparesis, severe IBD)
- 06Under 18 years of age

No. It is a once-weekly injection with a very thin, short needle into the soft part of the stomach or thigh. Most people say it is far easier than they expected, and your provider walks you through exactly how before you start.

Is it safe?

GLP-1 medications are prescription treatments, which is why a licensed provider reviews your full health history first and starts you at a low dose that increases slowly. They are not right for everyone, and your provider will tell you if it is not a fit for you.

How much weight could I lose?

In large published trials, people lost meaningful weight over many months, not overnight. Individual results vary by person, dose, and adherence, and no specific outcome is guaranteed.

Will I gain the weight back?

Weight management is ongoing. Many people continue on a maintenance plan, and your provider helps you find the right long-term approach for you.

What happens after I pay?

A licensed clinician reviews your order and health answers. Once approved, your medication ships directly to your door with free shipping, and our team sends order updates by email.

What if I am not approved?

Treatment does not proceed and no prescription ships unless a licensed provider determines that it is medically appropriate. The clinician or support team will follow up with next steps.

Tirzepatide is the most effective pharmacological weight-management compound ever to clear a phase-3 trial. It engages two appetite hormones, GLP-1 and GIP, rather than one, producing larger and more durable weight loss than any single-agonist GLP-1.

## How it works in the body

Tirzepatide is a synthetic peptide that simultaneously activates two receptors: GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) and GIP (glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide). The combined agonism slows gastric emptying, suppresses appetite via central pathways in the hypothalamus, improves insulin sensitivity, and reduces food noise. The dual mechanism is what produces the larger weight-loss effect compared with single-receptor GLP-1s like semaglutide.

### How much weight can I expect to lose on tirzepatide?

In the SURMOUNT-1 trial, adults on the highest dose lost an average of 20.9% of body weight at 72 weeks. Individual results vary and depend on dose, tolerance, and lifestyle.

### What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Tirzepatide is the most effective pharmacological weight-management compound ever to clear a phase-3 trial. It engages two appetite hormones, GLP-1 and GIP, rather than one, producing larger and more durable weight loss than any single-agonist GLP-1.

## How it works in the body

Tirzepatide is a synthetic peptide that simultaneously activates two receptors: GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) and GIP (glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide). The combined agonism slows gastric emptying, suppresses appetite via central pathways in the hypothalamus, improves insulin sensitivity, and reduces food noise. The dual mechanism is what produces the larger weight-loss effect compared with single-receptor GLP-1s like semaglutide.

Tirzepatide is the most effective pharmacological weight-management compound ever to clear a phase-3 trial. It engages two appetite hormones, GLP-1 and GIP, rather than one, producing larger and more durable weight loss than any single-agonist GLP-1.

## How it works in the body

Tirzepatide is a synthetic peptide that simultaneously activates two receptors: GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) and GIP (glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide). The combined agonism slows gastric emptying, suppresses appetite via central pathways in the hypothalamus, improves insulin sensitivity, and reduces food noise. The dual mechanism is what produces the larger weight-loss effect compared with single-receptor GLP-1s like semaglutide.

### Side effects, honestly.

#### Common

- · Nausea (most common during titration)
- · Constipation
- · Diarrhea
- · Decreased appetite (the therapeutic effect)
- · Fatigue, mild headache

#### Serious

- · Pancreatitis (rare)
- · Gallbladder disease
- · Hypoglycemia (especially with other diabetes medications)
- · Possible thyroid C-cell tumors (animal studies in rats; relevance to humans unknown)

### Who it's for. Who it isn't.

#### Suitable for

- · Adults with BMI ≥ 30, or BMI ≥ 27 with a weight-related condition
- · Patients who have not responded to lifestyle changes alone
- · Patients seeking the most effective available compound

#### Not suitable for

- · Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma
- · Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN-2)
- · History of severe pancreatitis
- · Pregnant or breastfeeding
- · Severe gastrointestinal disease

## Questions, answered.

### How much does compounded tirzepatide cost at HealthRX.com?

Compounded tirzepatide plans start at $179/mo with the annual option. The monthly Subscribe & Save plan is $193 for the first month, then $214 per month. The price you see at checkout is the price billed. No insurance required.

### Is compounded tirzepatide the same as Mounjaro or Zepbound?

Tirzepatide is the active molecule in branded Mounjaro and Zepbound. The HealthRX.com preparation is compounded by a licensed 503A pharmacy on a valid, patient-specific prescription. It is not the branded product.

### How much weight can I expect to lose on tirzepatide?

In the SURMOUNT-1 trial, adults on the highest dose lost an average of 20.9% of body weight at 72 weeks. Individual results vary and depend on dose, tolerance, and lifestyle.

### What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Tirzepatide activates two appetite hormones (GLP-1 and GIP), while semaglutide activates one (GLP-1). In trials tirzepatide produced larger average weight loss, though semaglutide has the longer track record and cardiovascular-outcomes data.

### Who should not take tirzepatide?

Tirzepatide is not appropriate for people with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN-2, a history of severe pancreatitis, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding. A licensed clinician reviews your history before prescribing.

## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

How old do I have to be to participate in the programs?

## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

How old do I have to be to participate in the programs?

At this time, patients have to be at least 18 years old to participate in the program.

LevelsRx offers multiple subscription types, all of which include comprehensive coaching and services with no hidden fees, membership costs, or lab charges. Subscription charges may appear on your credit card as "OPNLP LEVELSRX."

GLP-1 prescriptions are usually more cost-effective when covered by insurance, but the exact expense will depend on your insurance plan. ## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

How old do I have to be to participate in the programs?

## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

How old do I have to be to participate in the programs?

## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

## The answers you need

Find answers to frequently asked questions about our programs.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

How old do I have to be to participate in the programs?

At this time, patients have to be at least 18 years old to participate in the program.

What happens after I complete the eligibility quiz?

If you are eligible to participate in the LevelsRx program, you will have the option to schedule a prescription fill with a video visit or, depending on the state, schedule a prescription fill without a video visit.

Once you select your prescription fill type, you will be asked to sign up. Once paid, you will be prompted to create a password for your account. Note: your username is the email address you signed up with. You're almost done! The last step after creating your password is to complete your initial health history intake form—this can be accessed by selecting "Next" after creating your password. You will also receive an email if you haven't completed your health history intake form and can complete it by logging into the portal. Please be sure to complete this at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in your treatment plan.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

During your first appointment, your provider will discuss your health goals, review your medical history, order any necessary lab tests, and may order a prescription medication if deemed appropriate. Your provider will collaborate with you to create a personalized health plan. Alongside lifestyle recommendations, your care plan may include a prescription for weight loss medication.

Upon starting a weight loss medication, regular check-ins with your provider can be scheduled. The frequency of these visits can vary, but usually are once a month in the beginning. During these check-ins, the provider will evaluate your progress in weight loss, monitor your medication tolerance, arrange follow-up lab tests or prescription refills, and adjust your care plan as necessary.

Who qualifies for weight loss medications?

While prescriptions for weight loss medication cannot be guaranteed for every patient, if you are 18 years of age or older and meet specific criteria such as weight and certain associated health conditions, your healthcare provider may consider you eligible for a prescription.

Generally speaking, those who qualify are: individuals with overweight (BMI > 25) and those who are seeking maintenance therapy that have a BMI > 22 and if their current BMI < 27, have a history of obesity or are overweight and have previously been on a GLP-1 within the past 12 months.

Questions

Everything you need to know before getting started.

Do I need insurance to get started?

No. Longevity Meds works with or without insurance. Our pricing is fully transparent, so you always know exactly what you’re paying—no claims, no approvals, no hidden costs.

How do I know if I qualify for Semaglutide or Tirzepatide?

Start with a quick online intake. Your information is reviewed by a US-licensed medical provider who determines if Semaglutide or Tirzepatide is appropriate based on your health profile and goals.

What level of medical oversight is provided during treatment?

All patients receive clinician-reviewed care through Longevity Meds. Our licensed providers evaluate eligibility, dosing, and ongoing treatment considerations, ensuring care is delivered responsibly and within accepted clinical standards.

How long does it take to receive my medication?

Once approved, orders typically ship within 3–5 business days. Medications are delivered discreetly and include temperature-controlled cold shipping to maintain effectiveness.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

If you complete 90 consecutive days of your prescribed weight-loss treatment program and have no net reduction in body weight, you may request a refund of the eligible program fees paid for that 90-day treatment period, subject to the requirements
[see here](https://www.longevitymeds.com/legal/subscription-cancel-policy)

What kind of support will I receive?

You’ll have ongoing access to our care team for questions, guidance, and treatment support throughout your journey with Semaglutide or Tirzepatide.

How does tirzepatide work?

Tirzepatide works by activating both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, hormones involved in appetite regulation, blood sugar control, and digestion. It may help reduce hunger, support portion control, and assist with weight management when combined with clinician supervision and lifestyle modifications.

What are common tirzepatide side effects?

Common tirzepatide side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

How does semaglutide work?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that helps regulate appetite, blood sugar, and digestion. It may help patients feel fuller longer, reduce hunger, and support weight management when combined with lifestyle changes and clinician supervision.

What are common semaglutide side effects?

Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, while tirzepatide works as both a GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist. Both medications may support weight management and metabolic health, but treatment suitability depends on individual medical evaluation.

How much weight can I lose with GLP-1 medications?

Weight loss results vary depending on dosage, consistency, nutrition, activity level, and individual response. Many patients may experience meaningful weight reduction over time when treatment is combined with lifestyle modifications and clinician supervision.

Who may qualify for semaglutide or tirzepatide treatment?

Eligibility is determined by a licensed healthcare provider based on factors such as medical history, current health status, BMI, and treatment goals. Patients complete an online intake and clinical review before treatment consideration.

How long does it take to see results?

Some patients may begin noticing appetite changes and early weight loss within the first few weeks, while more significant results often develop over several months of consistent treatment and lifestyle support.

Are GLP-1 medications safe?

GLP-1 medications may be appropriate for many patients when prescribed and monitored by licensed healthcare professionals. Treatment suitability and risks should always be discussed with a qualified provider based on individual medical history.

What is a 503A pharmacy?

A 503A pharmacy is a state-licensed compounding pharmacy that prepares customized medications for individual patients based on a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

Is compounded GLP-1 FDA approved?

Compounded medications are not FDA approved in the same way commercially manufactured drugs are approved. Compounded GLP-1 medications may be prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies pursuant to a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

How are compounded GLP-1 medications made?

Compounded GLP-1 medications are prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies that follow strict quality standards. They use pharmaceutical-grade ingredients to create customized formulations based on a healthcare provider's prescription.

# Shipping, Returns & Refund Policy

We are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare services, including seamless consultations with medical professionals and affordable medications, along with strong support before and after your purchase. If you encounter any problems with your order or medication, please contact our support team right away.

### Cancellations and Refunds for Prescription Medications

You can terminate your subscription whenever you wish by accessing your secure, password-protected account dashboard. The rules below govern cancellations and refund eligibility specifically for prescription-based orders:

**Cancellation Before the Medical Consultation:** If you send a written cancellation request by email to support@longevitymeds.com before your consultation with a licensed physician is finished, you may qualify for a refund (subject to approval). Approved refunds will be issued.

**No Refunds or Cancellations After Consultation Completion:** Once the consultation is done and a prescription is approved, it is sent right away to the partnered pharmacy for preparation and dispensing. From that moment, the order becomes final and cannot be canceled. No refunds are available, no matter the delivery stage. This follows strict U.S. FDA guidelines that ban the return or resale of any dispensed prescription drugs.

**If the Prescription Is Not Approved:** Should the physician decline to issue the prescription, you will get a complete refund with no deductions or fees applied.

**Requests to Modify a Prescription After It Has Been Sent to the Pharmacy:** If you want to switch to a different prescription after it has already gone to the pharmacy, a $150 re-processing charge will apply. Any changes require re-evaluation by a licensed doctor and are not always approved.

**Compliance with Regulations:** Prescription orders become irreversible once forwarded to the pharmacy. Per FDA rules, dispensed or prepared prescription medications cannot be returned or refunded.

### Payment Terms

**Subscription Details:** All charges for services and products are processed through billing up front, with flexible renewal options available. Your plan may renew based on the selected renewal option unless you choose to cancel. You must provide a valid payment method at signup and ensure sufficient funds are available for any applicable renewals. You can manage or cancel your plan at any time through your secure dashboard.

**Required Commitment for Weight Loss Programs:** Programs involving medications like Tirzepatide or Semaglutide include a mandatory three-month term, as the full supply is provided up front. You are required to complete this entire period regardless of your selected billing option. Canceling early will result in an early termination fee.

**Billing up front with Renewal Options:** These are available as no-interest plans without credit checks. If you cancel any plan with flexible renewal options before completing the current plan, an early cancellation fee may still apply. You are responsible for ensuring that any scheduled or applicable renewal payments are completed successfully.

### Chargebacks and Failed Payments

**Chargebacks:** Attempting to reverse or dispute a valid charge (a "chargeback") for delivered services or fulfilled orders counts as a violation of these terms. We will actively challenge any such disputes and supply evidence to the card issuer, such as records of the consultation, prescription approval, and order status. If a chargeback is filed without first trying to resolve the matter with us directly, you may face a $199 chargeback handling fee added to your balance. We also retain the right to take legal steps and seek reimbursement for related expenses, including attorney fees and court costs.

**Declined Payments and Overdue Balances:** Participants in three-month programs remain responsible for the entire commitment even on installment plans. If payments fail and the full amount isn't covered, the unpaid portion becomes delinquent. We may send overdue amounts to a collections agency, and you will then owe all collection-related fees plus a 50% surcharge on the remaining balance. Legal recovery options may also be pursued at your expense.

### Returns, Replacements, and Shipping (included for context as part of the overall policy)

Medications (such as sterile GLP-1s and peptides) are shipped overnight in specialized cold packaging with insulation and ice packs to maintain quality. Products undergo lab testing for stability during transit and can safely handle room temperature (under 86°F/30°C) for up to 10 days or brief higher exposures—refrigerate promptly upon receipt.

**Wrong or Damaged Items:** Report any incorrect product or damage within 7 days of receipt via your patient portal (use the replacement form). Approved cases receive a replacement after review. Late claims may not be honored.

**Delivery Problems:** For issues like wrong address delivery, delays, or damage, notify us within 7 days of delivery (or expected date). Undelivered packages require a 3-day buffer after the estimated arrival before we process replacements.

**Address Errors:** Mistakes in the shipping address entered at checkout are your responsibility. We may reship for a $150 fee covering re-processing, physician oversight, handling, and shipping. Once in transit, rerouting isn't always possible.

Frequently Asked

Questions

Everything you need to know before getting started.

Do I need insurance to get started?

No. Longevity Meds works with or without insurance. Our pricing is fully transparent, so you always know exactly what you’re paying—no claims, no approvals, no hidden costs.

How do I know if I qualify for Semaglutide or Tirzepatide?

Start with a quick online intake. Your information is reviewed by a US-licensed medical provider who determines if Semaglutide or Tirzepatide is appropriate based on your health profile and goals.

What level of medical oversight is provided during treatment?

All patients receive clinician-reviewed care through Longevity Meds. Our licensed providers evaluate eligibility, dosing, and ongoing treatment considerations, ensuring care is delivered responsibly and within accepted clinical standards.

How long does it take to receive my medication?

Once approved, orders typically ship within 3–5 business days. Medications are delivered discreetly and include temperature-controlled cold shipping to maintain effectiveness.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

If you complete 90 consecutive days of your prescribed weight-loss treatment program and have no net reduction in body weight, you may request a refund of the eligible program fees paid for that 90-day treatment period, subject to the requirements
[see here](https://www.longevitymeds.com/legal/subscription-cancel-policy)

What kind of support will I receive?

You’ll have ongoing access to our care team for questions, guidance, and treatment support throughout your journey with Semaglutide or Tirzepatide.

How does tirzepatide work?

Tirzepatide works by activating both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, hormones involved in appetite regulation, blood sugar control, and digestion. It may help reduce hunger, support portion control, and assist with weight management when combined with clinician supervision and lifestyle modifications.

What are common tirzepatide side effects?

Common tirzepatide side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

How does semaglutide work?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that helps regulate appetite, blood sugar, and digestion. It may help patients feel fuller longer, reduce hunger, and support weight management when combined with lifestyle changes and clinician supervision.

What are common semaglutide side effects?

Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, while tirzepatide works as both a GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist. Both medications may support weight management and metabolic health, but treatment suitability depends on individual medical evaluation.

How much weight can I lose with GLP-1 medications?

Weight loss results vary depending on dosage, consistency, nutrition, activity level, and individual response. Many patients may experience meaningful weight reduction over time when treatment is combined with lifestyle modifications and clinician supervision.

Who may qualify for semaglutide or tirzepatide treatment?

Eligibility is determined by a licensed healthcare provider based on factors such as medical history, current health status, BMI, and treatment goals. Patients complete an online intake and clinical review before treatment consideration.

How long does it take to see results?

Some patients may begin noticing appetite changes and early weight loss within the first few weeks, while more significant results often develop over several months of consistent treatment and lifestyle support.

Are GLP-1 medications safe?

GLP-1 medications may be appropriate for many patients when prescribed and monitored by licensed healthcare professionals. Treatment suitability and risks should always be discussed with a qualified provider based on individual medical history.

What is a 503A pharmacy?

A 503A pharmacy is a state-licensed compounding pharmacy that prepares customized medications for individual patients based on a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

Is compounded GLP-1 FDA approved?

Compounded medications are not FDA approved in the same way commercially manufactured drugs are approved. Compounded GLP-1 medications may be prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies pursuant to a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

How are compounded GLP-1 medications made?

Compounded GLP-1 medications are prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies that follow strict quality standards. They use pharmaceutical-grade ingredients to create customized formulations based on a healthcare provider's prescription.

# Shipping, Returns & Refund Policy

We are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare services, including seamless consultations with medical professionals and affordable medications, along with strong support before and after your purchase. If you encounter any problems with your order or medication, please contact our support team right away.

### Cancellations and Refunds for Prescription Medications

You can terminate your subscription whenever you wish by accessing your secure, password-protected account dashboard. The rules below govern cancellations and refund eligibility specifically for prescription-based orders:

**Cancellation Before the Medical Consultation:** If you send a written cancellation request by email to support@longevitymeds.com before your consultation with a licensed physician is finished, you may qualify for a refund (subject to approval). Approved refunds will be issued.

**No Refunds or Cancellations After Consultation Completion:** Once the consultation is done and a prescription is approved, it is sent right away to the partnered pharmacy for preparation and dispensing. From that moment, the order becomes final and cannot be canceled. No refunds are available, no matter the delivery stage. This follows strict U.S. FDA guidelines that ban the return or resale of any dispensed prescription drugs.

**If the Prescription Is Not Approved:** Should the physician decline to issue the prescription, you will get a complete refund with no deductions or fees applied.

**Requests to Modify a Prescription After It Has Been Sent to the Pharmacy:** If you want to switch to a different prescription after it has already gone to the pharmacy, a $150 re-processing charge will apply. Any changes require re-evaluation by a licensed doctor and are not always approved.

**Compliance with Regulations:** Prescription orders become irreversible once forwarded to the pharmacy. Per FDA rules, dispensed or prepared prescription medications cannot be returned or refunded.

### Payment Terms

**Subscription Details:** All charges for services and products are processed through billing up front, with flexible renewal options available. Your plan may renew based on the selected renewal option unless you choose to cancel. You must provide a valid payment method at signup and ensure sufficient funds are available for any applicable renewals. You can manage or cancel your plan at any time through your secure dashboard.

**Required Commitment for Weight Loss Programs:** Programs involving medications like Tirzepatide or Semaglutide include a mandatory three-month term, as the full supply is provided up front. You are required to complete this entire period regardless of your selected billing option. Canceling early will result in an early termination fee.

**Billing up front with Renewal Options:** These are available as no-interest plans without credit checks. If you cancel any plan with flexible renewal options before completing the current plan, an early cancellation fee may still apply. You are responsible for ensuring that any scheduled or applicable renewal payments are completed successfully.

### Chargebacks and Failed Payments

**Chargebacks:** Attempting to reverse or dispute a valid charge (a "chargeback") for delivered services or fulfilled orders counts as a violation of these terms. We will actively challenge any such disputes and supply evidence to the card issuer, such as records of the consultation, prescription approval, and order status. If a chargeback is filed without first trying to resolve the matter with us directly, you may face a $199 chargeback handling fee added to your balance. We also retain the right to take legal steps and seek reimbursement for related expenses, including attorney fees and court costs.

**Declined Payments and Overdue Balances:** Participants in three-month programs remain responsible for the entire commitment even on installment plans. If payments fail and the full amount isn't covered, the unpaid portion becomes delinquent. We may send overdue amounts to a collections agency, and you will then owe all collection-related fees plus a 50% surcharge on the remaining balance. Legal recovery options may also be pursued at your expense.

### Returns, Replacements, and Shipping (included for context as part of the overall policy)

Medications (such as sterile GLP-1s and peptides) are shipped overnight in specialized cold packaging with insulation and ice packs to maintain quality. Products undergo lab testing for stability during transit and can safely handle room temperature (under 86°F/30°C) for up to 10 days or brief higher exposures—refrigerate promptly upon receipt.

**Wrong or Damaged Items:** Report any incorrect product or damage within 7 days of receipt via your patient portal (use the replacement form). Approved cases receive a replacement after review. Late claims may not be honored.

**Delivery Problems:** For issues like wrong address delivery, delays, or damage, notify us within 7 days of delivery (or expected date). Undelivered packages require a 3-day buffer after the estimated arrival before we process replacements.

**Address Errors:** Mistakes in the shipping address entered at checkout are your responsibility. We may reship for a $150 fee covering re-processing, physician oversight, handling, and shipping. Once in transit, rerouting isn't always possible.

Questions

Everything you need to know before getting started.

Do I need insurance to get started?

No. Longevity Meds works with or without insurance. Our pricing is fully transparent, so you always know exactly what you’re paying—no claims, no approvals, no hidden costs.

How do I know if I qualify for Semaglutide or Tirzepatide?

Start with a quick online intake. Your information is reviewed by a US-licensed medical provider who determines if Semaglutide or Tirzepatide is appropriate based on your health profile and goals.

What level of medical oversight is provided during treatment?

All patients receive clinician-reviewed care through Longevity Meds. Our licensed providers evaluate eligibility, dosing, and ongoing treatment considerations, ensuring care is delivered responsibly and within accepted clinical standards.

How long does it take to receive my medication?

Once approved, orders typically ship within 3–5 business days. Medications are delivered discreetly and include temperature-controlled cold shipping to maintain effectiveness.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

If you complete 90 consecutive days of your prescribed weight-loss treatment program and have no net reduction in body weight, you may request a refund of the eligible program fees paid for that 90-day treatment period, subject to the requirements
[see here](https://www.longevitymeds.com/legal/subscription-cancel-policy)

What kind of support will I receive?

You’ll have ongoing access to our care team for questions, guidance, and treatment support throughout your journey with Semaglutide or Tirzepatide.

How does tirzepatide work?

Tirzepatide works by activating both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, hormones involved in appetite regulation, blood sugar control, and digestion. It may help reduce hunger, support portion control, and assist with weight management when combined with clinician supervision and lifestyle modifications.

What are common tirzepatide side effects?

Common tirzepatide side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

How does semaglutide work?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that helps regulate appetite, blood sugar, and digestion. It may help patients feel fuller longer, reduce hunger, and support weight management when combined with lifestyle changes and clinician supervision.

What are common semaglutide side effects?

Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, while tirzepatide works as both a GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist. Both medications may support weight management and metabolic health, but treatment suitability depends on individual medical evaluation.

How much weight can I lose with GLP-1 medications?

Weight loss results vary depending on dosage, consistency, nutrition, activity level, and individual response. Many patients may experience meaningful weight reduction over time when treatment is combined with lifestyle modifications and clinician supervision.

Who may qualify for semaglutide or tirzepatide treatment?

Eligibility is determined by a licensed healthcare provider based on factors such as medical history, current health status, BMI, and treatment goals. Patients complete an online intake and clinical review before treatment consideration.

How long does it take to see results?

Some patients may begin noticing appetite changes and early weight loss within the first few weeks, while more significant results often develop over several months of consistent treatment and lifestyle support.

Are GLP-1 medications safe?

GLP-1 medications may be appropriate for many patients when prescribed and monitored by licensed healthcare professionals. Treatment suitability and risks should always be discussed with a qualified provider based on individual medical history.

What is a 503A pharmacy?

A 503A pharmacy is a state-licensed compounding pharmacy that prepares customized medications for individual patients based on a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

Is compounded GLP-1 FDA approved?

Compounded medications are not FDA approved in the same way commercially manufactured drugs are approved. Compounded GLP-1 medications may be prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies pursuant to a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

How are compounded GLP-1 medications made?

Compounded GLP-1 medications are prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies that follow strict quality standards. They use pharmaceutical-grade ingredients to create customized formulations based on a healthcare provider's prescription.

# Shipping, Returns & Refund Policy

We are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare services, including seamless consultations with medical professionals and affordable medications, along with strong support before and after your purchase. If you encounter any problems with your order or medication, please contact our support team right away.

### Cancellations and Refunds for Prescription Medications

You can terminate your subscription whenever you wish by accessing your secure, password-protected account dashboard. The rules below govern cancellations and refund eligibility specifically for prescription-based orders:

**Cancellation Before the Medical Consultation:** If you send a written cancellation request by email to support@longevitymeds.com before your consultation with a licensed physician is finished, you may qualify for a refund (subject to approval). Approved refunds will be issued.

**No Refunds or Cancellations After Consultation Completion:** Once the consultation is done and a prescription is approved, it is sent right away to the partnered pharmacy for preparation and dispensing. From that moment, the order becomes final and cannot be canceled. No refunds are available, no matter the delivery stage. This follows strict U.S. FDA guidelines that ban the return or resale of any dispensed prescription drugs.

**If the Prescription Is Not Approved:** Should the physician decline to issue the prescription, you will get a complete refund with no deductions or fees applied.

**Requests to Modify a Prescription After It Has Been Sent to the Pharmacy:** If you want to switch to a different prescription after it has already gone to the pharmacy, a $150 re-processing charge will apply. Any changes require re-evaluation by a licensed doctor and are not always approved.

**Compliance with Regulations:** Prescription orders become irreversible once forwarded to the pharmacy. Per FDA rules, dispensed or prepared prescription medications cannot be returned or refunded.

### Payment Terms

**Subscription Details:** All charges for services and products are processed through billing up front, with flexible renewal options available. Your plan may renew based on the selected renewal option unless you choose to cancel. You must provide a valid payment method at signup and ensure sufficient funds are available for any applicable renewals. You can manage or cancel your plan at any time through your secure dashboard.

**Required Commitment for Weight Loss Programs:** Programs involving medications like Tirzepatide or Semaglutide include a mandatory three-month term, as the full supply is provided up front. You are required to complete this entire period regardless of your selected billing option. Canceling early will result in an early termination fee.

**Billing up front with Renewal Options:** These are available as no-interest plans without credit checks. If you cancel any plan with flexible renewal options before completing the current plan, an early cancellation fee may still apply. You are responsible for ensuring that any scheduled or applicable renewal payments are completed successfully.

### Chargebacks and Failed Payments

**Chargebacks:** Attempting to reverse or dispute a valid charge (a "chargeback") for delivered services or fulfilled orders counts as a violation of these terms. We will actively challenge any such disputes and supply evidence to the card issuer, such as records of the consultation, prescription approval, and order status. If a chargeback is filed without first trying to resolve the matter with us directly, you may face a $199 chargeback handling fee added to your balance. We also retain the right to take legal steps and seek reimbursement for related expenses, including attorney fees and court costs.

**Declined Payments and Overdue Balances:** Participants in three-month programs remain responsible for the entire commitment even on installment plans. If payments fail and the full amount isn't covered, the unpaid portion becomes delinquent. We may send overdue amounts to a collections agency, and you will then owe all collection-related fees plus a 50% surcharge on the remaining balance. Legal recovery options may also be pursued at your expense.

### Returns, Replacements, and Shipping (included for context as part of the overall policy)

Medications (such as sterile GLP-1s and peptides) are shipped overnight in specialized cold packaging with insulation and ice packs to maintain quality. Products undergo lab testing for stability during transit and can safely handle room temperature (under 86°F/30°C) for up to 10 days or brief higher exposures—refrigerate promptly upon receipt.

**Delivery Problems:** For issues like wrong address delivery, delays, or damage, notify us within 7 days of delivery (or expected date). Undelivered packages require a 3-day buffer after the estimated arrival before we process replacements.

Do I need insurance to get started?

No. Longevity Meds works with or without insurance. Our pricing is fully transparent, so you always know exactly what you’re paying—no claims, no approvals, no hidden costs.

How do I know if I qualify for Semaglutide or Tirzepatide?

Start with a quick online intake. Your information is reviewed by a US-licensed medical provider who determines if Semaglutide or Tirzepatide is appropriate based on your health profile and goals.

What level of medical oversight is provided during treatment?

All patients receive clinician-reviewed care through Longevity Meds. Our licensed providers evaluate eligibility, dosing, and ongoing treatment considerations, ensuring care is delivered responsibly and within accepted clinical standards.

How long does it take to receive my medication?

Once approved, orders typically ship within 3–5 business days. Medications are delivered discreetly and include temperature-controlled cold shipping to maintain effectiveness.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

If you complete 90 consecutive days of your prescribed weight-loss treatment program and have no net reduction in body weight, you may request a refund of the eligible program fees paid for that 90-day treatment period, subject to the requirements
[see here](https://www.longevitymeds.com/legal/subscription-cancel-policy)

What kind of support will I receive?

You’ll have ongoing access to our care team for questions, guidance, and treatment support throughout your journey with Semaglutide or Tirzepatide.

How does tirzepatide work?

Tirzepatide works by activating both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, hormones involved in appetite regulation, blood sugar control, and digestion. It may help reduce hunger, support portion control, and assist with weight management when combined with clinician supervision and lifestyle modifications.

What are common tirzepatide side effects?

Common tirzepatide side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

How does semaglutide work?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that helps regulate appetite, blood sugar, and digestion. It may help patients feel fuller longer, reduce hunger, and support weight management when combined with lifestyle changes and clinician supervision.

What are common semaglutide side effects?

Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach discomfort, reduced appetite, and fatigue. Side effects vary by individual and patients should consult a licensed healthcare provider before starting treatment.

What is the difference between tirzepatide and semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, while tirzepatide works as both a GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist. Both medications may support weight management and metabolic health, but treatment suitability depends on individual medical evaluation.

How much weight can I lose with GLP-1 medications?

Weight loss results vary depending on dosage, consistency, nutrition, activity level, and individual response. Many patients may experience meaningful weight reduction over time when treatment is combined with lifestyle modifications and clinician supervision.

Who may qualify for semaglutide or tirzepatide treatment?

Eligibility is determined by a licensed healthcare provider based on factors such as medical history, current health status, BMI, and treatment goals. Patients complete an online intake and clinical review before treatment consideration.

How long does it take to see results?

Some patients may begin noticing appetite changes and early weight loss within the first few weeks, while more significant results often develop over several months of consistent treatment and lifestyle support.

Are GLP-1 medications safe?

GLP-1 medications may be appropriate for many patients when prescribed and monitored by licensed healthcare professionals. Treatment suitability and risks should always be discussed with a qualified provider based on individual medical history.

What is a 503A pharmacy?

A 503A pharmacy is a state-licensed compounding pharmacy that prepares customized medications for individual patients based on a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

Is compounded GLP-1 FDA approved?

Compounded medications are not FDA approved in the same way commercially manufactured drugs are approved. Compounded GLP-1 medications may be prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies pursuant to a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.

How are compounded GLP-1 medications made?

Compounded GLP-1 medications are prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies that follow strict quality standards. They use pharmaceutical-grade ingredients to create customized formulations based on a healthcare provider's prescription.

# Shipping, Returns & Refund Policy

We are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare services, including seamless consultations with medical professionals and affordable medications, along with strong support before and after your purchase. If you encounter any problems with your order or medication, please contact our support team right away.

### Cancellations and Refunds for Prescription Medications

You can terminate your subscription whenever you wish by accessing your secure, password-protected account dashboard. The rules below govern cancellations and refund eligibility specifically for prescription-based orders:

**Cancellation Before the Medical Consultation:** If you send a written cancellation request by email to support@longevitymeds.com before your consultation with a licensed physician is finished, you may qualify for a refund (subject to approval). Approved refunds will be issued.

**No Refunds or Cancellations After Consultation Completion:** Once the consultation is done and a prescription is approved, it is sent right away to the partnered pharmacy for preparation and dispensing. From that moment, the order becomes final and cannot be canceled. No refunds are available, no matter the delivery stage. This follows strict U.S. FDA guidelines that ban the return or resale of any dispensed prescription drugs.

**If the Prescription Is Not Approved:** Should the physician decline to issue the prescription, you will get a complete refund with no deductions or fees applied.

**Requests to Modify a Prescription After It Has Been Sent to the Pharmacy:** If you want to switch to a different prescription after it has already gone to the pharmacy, a $150 re-processing charge will apply. Any changes require re-evaluation by a licensed doctor and are not always approved.

**Compliance with Regulations:** Prescription orders become irreversible once forwarded to the pharmacy. Per FDA rules, dispensed or prepared prescription medications cannot be returned or refunded.

### Payment Terms

**Subscription Details:** All charges for services and products are processed through billing up front, with flexible renewal options available. Your plan may renew based on the selected renewal option unless you choose to cancel. You must provide a valid payment method at signup and ensure sufficient funds are available for any applicable renewals. You can manage or cancel your plan at any time through your secure dashboard.

**Required Commitment for Weight Loss Programs:** Programs involving medications like Tirzepatide or Semaglutide include a mandatory three-month term, as the full supply is provided up front. You are required to complete this entire period regardless of your selected billing option. Canceling early will result in an early termination fee.

**Billing up front with Renewal Options:** These are available as no-interest plans without credit checks. If you cancel any plan with flexible renewal options before completing the current plan, an early cancellation fee may still apply. You are responsible for ensuring that any scheduled or applicable renewal payments are completed successfully.

### Chargebacks and Failed Payments

**Chargebacks:** Attempting to reverse or dispute a valid charge (a "chargeback") for delivered services or fulfilled orders counts as a violation of these terms. We will actively challenge any such disputes and supply evidence to the card issuer, such as records of the consultation, prescription approval, and order status. If a chargeback is filed without first trying to resolve the matter with us directly, you may face a $199 chargeback handling fee added to your balance. We also retain the right to take legal steps and seek reimbursement for related expenses, including attorney fees and court costs.

**Declined Payments and Overdue Balances:** Participants in three-month programs remain responsible for the entire commitment even on installment plans. If payments fail and the full amount isn't covered, the unpaid portion becomes delinquent. We may send overdue amounts to a collections agency, and you will then owe all collection-related fees plus a 50% surcharge on the remaining balance. Legal recovery options may also be pursued at your expense.

### Returns, Replacements, and Shipping (included for context as part of the overall policy)

Medications (such as sterile GLP-1s and peptides) are shipped overnight in specialized cold packaging with insulation and ice packs to maintain quality. Products undergo lab testing for stability during transit and can safely handle room temperature (under 86°F/30°C) for up to 10 days or brief higher exposures—refrigerate promptly upon receipt.

**Wrong or Damaged Items:** Report any incorrect product or damage within 7 days of receipt via your patient portal (use the replacement form). Approved cases receive a replacement after review. Late claims may not be honored.

**Delivery Problems:** For issues like wrong address delivery, delays, or damage, notify us within 7 days of delivery (or expected date). Undelivered packages require a 3-day buffer after the estimated arrival before we process replacements.

**Address Errors:** Mistakes in the shipping address entered at checkout are your responsibility. We may reship for a $150 fee covering re-processing, physician oversight, handling, and shipping. Once in transit, rerouting isn't always possible.
